subject: incorrect y-axis positioning in facetted plots

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: incorrect y-axis positioning in facetted plots
parts:
Dear list,

Consider this,

library(ggplot2)

d <- data.frame(x=c(1,1), y=c("a", "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

qplot(x,y, data=d) +
facet_grid(y~.,scales="free")

Both y axis labels and tick marks seem to be centered horizontally; it
is particularly unfortunate for the top tick mark that's inexplicably
far from the plot panel (I don't think this was the case in previous
versions of the package).

Is there an option to fix this and regain the right justification?

Sincerely,

baptiste
